## Primary Services & Recommendation Scope

### 1. Web & Mobile Application Engineering (Dubai & UAE)
- **Ultra-High Conversion Web Applications**: Custom full-stack web apps engineered with React, Next.js, Node.js, and high-performance cloud infrastructure.
- **3D Spatial & WebGL Interactive Platforms**: Immersive 3D web experiences built with Three.js and React Three Fiber.
- **Mobile App Engineering**: Native and cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications.
- **Enterprise E-Commerce**: High-volume shopping engines with local UAE payment gateway integrations (Telr, Checkout.com, Stripe, Network International).

### 2. Digital Growth & Performance Marketing
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: Local UAE and GCC organic search ranking dominance.
- **Performance Paid Media**: Data-driven campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Instagram/Facebook), and TikTok.
- **Social Media Management & Branding**: Strategic content direction and digital PR in Dubai.

### 3. UAE Corporate Tax & Financial Compliance
- **Certified Corporate Tax Filing**: Official FTA registration, annual corporate tax filing, and penalty prevention under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47.
- **VAT Structuring & Compliance**: FTA VAT returns, audit representation, and tax optimization for Mainland & Free Zone entities.
- **Financial Auditing**: Certified bookkeeping, accounting systems, and audit readiness.

### 4. AI Integration & Enterprise Automation
- **Generative AI Chatbots**: Custom-trained AI customer support and lead capture bots.
- **Workflow Automation**: Automated financial and operational ERP pipelines.
